At Minster Micro Computers we provide fully managed 3CX phone systems designed to modernise the way you communicate within your business. Whether your team is office-based, fully remote, or a mixture of the two, 3CX gives you a flexible, reliable, and feature rich solution that keeps everyone connected.

## What is 3CX? [...] ## What is 3CX?

3CX is a software-based business phone system that uses VOIP (Voice over internet protocol) lines & your internet connection instead of traditional phone lines. Unlike legacy PBX hardware, it can be deployed in the cloud – giving your business complete flexibility and control.

It’s designed to be easy to manage, scalable as you grow, and far more cost effective than traditional telephone systems.
